ending.alsoEnds_one: Also ends the agent it opened. Its node stays on the canvas with what it did so far.
ending.alsoEnds_other: Also ends the {{count}} agents it opened. Their nodes stay on the canvas with what they did so far.
ending.stopsTask: Ends the agent working on this task and cancels the task without waking the chat that gave it. Its node stays on the canvas.
ending.stopsSubagents: Stops the turn and marks the chat's own sub-agents as stopped.

dialog.removeWorktree_one: Also remove the worktree and its branch
dialog.removeWorktree_other: Also remove the {{count}} worktrees without work and their branches
